login.select_demo_user: Select a demo user to log in

setup.title: Initial Node Setup
setup.welcome: Welcome. Let's set up your federated mutual credit node.
setup.select_language_desc: Choose the language for the installation and the node. You can change it later.
setup.preset_desc: Choose a profile with sample data based on your community's philosophy. This will apply schedules, catalog rules, texts and initial colors.
setup.preset_universal_note: Basic rules are always loaded: how mutual credit works, federation between nodes, symmetric limits and the energy model. These rules apply to all communities. The preset you choose here adds community-specific configuration (schedules, dietary rules, texts).
setup.preset_empty_note: You chose to install without preloaded data. Universal federated rules (mutual credit, federation, energy) will be loaded and you can configure everything else manually from the admin panel.
setup.preset_load_error: Could not load presets. You can continue without a preset and configure everything manually later. Universal federated rules will still be loaded.
setup.admin_username_min: Username must be at least 3 characters
setup.password_required: Password must be at least 8 characters
setup.already_initialized_desc: This node has already been configured. Log in to continue.
setup.review_desc: Verify everything is correct before initializing the node.
setup.server_error: Could not connect to the server
setup.node_domain_desc: Unique domain for federation (cannot be changed later)
setup.admin_display_name_desc: Optional. Name visible in the system
setup.password_security_note: This password is used to log in. Ed25519 cryptographic keys for the user will also be generated automatically.
setup.auto_gen_keys: Ed25519 keys for the administrator user
setup.auto_gen_perms: All permissions assigned to the administrator role
setup.password_warning: Make sure to remember your password. There is no way to recover it without the account recovery process.
setup.node_public_key_desc: Save this key. You need it to federate with other nodes: each node must register the other's public key.

over_limit.banner_title: Your account is over the credit limit.
over_limit.banner_desc: You cannot make new purchases until you regularize your balance. You need to receive TQ (by selling or receiving transfers) to get back within your limit. If you don't regularize soon, you may be penalized by the assembly.
over_limit.profile_warning: Over credit limit — Your balance is below your limit. You cannot make new purchases until you regularize.

pending_admission.title: Your account is pending approval
pending_admission.desc: While waiting for the assembly's decision, you can only view your application status.

errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to perform this action
